plan.title: Gender Parity in Fitness Improvement
plan.subtitle: Comparing baseline and endline performance metrics for boys and girls

panels.title: Total Participants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM (SELECT "Child ID" FROM "baseline" UNION SELECT "Child ID" FROM "endline")

panels.title: Average Shuttle Run Time (sec)
panels.sql: SELECT "Gender", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS avg_time FROM "baseline" GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT "Gender", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS avg_time FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Average Sit-ups
panels.sql: SELECT "Gender", AVG("Sit ups") AS avg_situps FROM "baseline" GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT "Gender", AVG("Sit ups") AS avg_situps FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Improvement by Gender
panels.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT "Gender", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS base_shuttle, AVG("Sit ups") AS base_situps FROM "baseline" GROUP BY 1), e AS (SELECT "Gender", AVG("Shuttle run sec") AS end_shuttle, AVG("Sit ups") AS end_situps FROM "endline" GROUP BY 1) SELECT b."Gender" AS gender, b.base_shuttle, e.end_shuttle, (b.base_shuttle - e.end_shuttle) AS shuttle_improvement, b.base_situps, e.end_situps, (e.end_situps - b.base_situps) AS situps_improvement FROM b JOIN e ON b."Gender" = e."Gender" ORDER BY 1

plan.narrative:
This report examines whether boys and girls are improving at the same rate in physical fitness. We compare the average shuttle run times and sit-up counts from the baseline to the endline assessment.

The total number of participants tracked is {{p1}}. The bar charts show the average performance for each gender at both time points. A decrease in shuttle run time indicates improvement, while an increase in sit-ups indicates improvement.

The table below details the specific improvement metrics for each gender. The 'shuttle_improvement' column shows the reduction in time (positive is better), and 'situps_improvement' shows the increase in count (positive is better). By comparing these values, we can see if one gender is outpacing the other in specific areas.
